verdict.rationale: Open WebUI exposes an API: API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, and there is an OpenAI-compatible gateway. That makes the axis applicable. However, nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
